nodes.name: .env.example
nodes.summary: Template for local frontend environment variables, defining the backend API base URL used against the uvicorn dev server.

nodes.name: .oxlintrc.json
nodes.summary: Oxlint configuration enabling the React, TypeScript, and Oxc plugin rule sets, including enforcement of React's rules-of-hooks.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Boilerplate README from the Vite React + TypeScript template, covering the available Vite plugins, the (unused) React Compiler option, and how to expand Oxlint with type-aware rules.

nodes.name: index.html
nodes.summary: HTML entry point for the Vite SPA — sets the Unifolio page title/description, loads Google Fonts (DM Sans, Manrope), and mounts the React app via src/main.tsx.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Frontend package manifest declaring React 19 as the runtime dependency and Vite, TypeScript, Vitest, and Oxlint as the dev toolchain, with dev/build/lint/test/preview scripts.

nodes.name: tsconfig.app.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript project config for the application source (src/): ES2023/DOM target, bundler module resolution, strict unused-locals/params linting, and JSX in react-jsx mode.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: Root TypeScript solution file with no direct source files — references the app and node project configs to enable TypeScript project references.

nodes.name: tsconfig.node.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript project config for Node-side tooling (vite.config.ts): ES2023 target, Node types, and nodenext module resolution, separate from the app's browser config.
